// Root Directory: Project → Settings → General → Root Directory MUST be set to `apps/web`. With that set, the commands below run from apps/web; we `cd ../..` to reach the workspace root only for the install step.
// install: Walk up to the repo root for the workspace install (pnpm needs to see pnpm-workspace.yaml), then build @vivasvana/db so its dist/ exists by the time Next.js compiles. Using `cd ../..` keeps Vercel's per-step cwd reset behaviour intact — each command starts in apps/web.
// build: Don't override — let Vercel run `next build` itself. Wrapping it in `pnpm turbo` hid the Next.js build from Vercel's framework-aware output discovery, so it couldn't find .next/ after the build finished.
// ignoreCommand: Skip rebuild if neither apps/web nor packages/* changed. `cd ../..` to run git from the repo root. Exit 0 = skip, Exit 1 = build.
ignoreCommand: cd ../.. && git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- apps/web packages || exit 1
